edges.notes: runc is the OCI reference implementation; executes bundles per the Runtime Specification.
Linux cgroups/namespaces for default build targets; other OS ports have different matrices.
containerd commonly invokes runc (or compatible runtime) to start OCI bundles.
Podman commonly uses runc on Linux by default; runtime selection is configurable.
CRI-O commonly uses runc as low-level runtime; alternatives supported per docs.
OCI images unpack into OCI runtime bundles that runc-class runtimes execute.
Substitutable low-level OCI runtime on Linux (crun vs runc).
Substitutable low-level isolation boundary for OCI bundles: namespace-isolated runc vs VM-backed Kata (different threat models).
Substitutable low-level OCI runtime on Linux: Linux-namespace runc vs gVisor runsc syscall interposition model.
